description: Fresh-milk expenditure, 43 small areas (Arora & Lahiri 1997, JASA 92:1555-1562; You & Chapman 2006). Fay-Herriot model yi ~ as.factor(MajorArea) with vardir = SD^2.

data_source.note: Read-only GitHub mirror of the CRAN sae package data/milk.rda, converted to CSV (columns unchanged, values exact as stored). Example call published in Molina & Marhuenda (2015), The R Journal 7(1):81-98, Example 1, https://journal.r-project.org/archive/2015/RJ-2015-007/RJ-2015-007.pdf

published_source.title: r-sig-mixed-models thread comparing sae::eblupFH with nlme, metafor and SAS on the milk data (posted output)
published_source.note: The R Journal paper shows the milk example only as a figure; the numerical output below is the printed output posted to the R mailing list archive. sae uses Fisher scoring with PRECISION = 1e-4, so its last digits differ slightly from the exact optimum; metafor::rma and PROC MIXED agree.
